items.title: AI Speed to Leads Launches to Answer Every Web Lead in About 60 Seconds With a Consent-Only AI Voice Call
items.summary: AI Speed to Leads, from Denver's Eye To Ad Media, answers each new web lead with an instant email and, for leads who consented, an AI voice call in about 60 seconds.
items.content_text: Eye To Ad Media has launched AI Speed to Leads, a service that answers every new web lead for a business in about 60 seconds. Each lead gets an instant email reply from the business. Leads who checked the business's consent box also get a natural-sounding phone call from Lily, the service's AI voice assistant, within about a minute. Lily says she is an AI, asks the business's own qualifying questions one at a time, scores the lead A, B or C, and books the best fits on the owner's calendar with a short summary and the call recording. The service is built for businesses that live on quote requests: bath and shower remodelers, roofers, HVAC and plumbing companies, painters, solar, window and siding installers, med spas and dealers. In a Harvard Business Review audit of 2,241 companies, the average business took 42 hours to respond to a web lead and only 37% answered within an hour. AI Speed to Leads works with the forms a business already has. Website, Facebook, Google and lead-service forms send a copy of each lead to one webhook, so no new website or CRM is needed.
